name: Controlled build-wave engine
verified_behaviors: approved structured plans contain one to seven waves and supply the authoritative total wave count
prepared manifests bind the exact approved plan, state, wave definition, scope, inputs, dependencies, tests, render targets, and completion criteria
manifest mutation after state binding is rejected
engine control artifacts are not misclassified as approved product scope
out-of-scope product changes and unverifiable change kinds are rejected
changed product files require current SHA-256 evidence and deleted files use an explicit deleted state
every planned test and completion criterion passes before a complete handoff is accepted
render targets pass or record an evidence-backed not-applicable result
structured handoff, readable handoff.md, verification receipt, and state bind each other by SHA-256
dependent waves recheck completed dependency product hashes and readable handoff bytes
implementation worker, independent verifier, and Unslop reviewer are distinct and all reviews pass
the state controller re-runs verification before closing a wave
the controller advances to the next approved wave or rendering and rejects a direct building-to-rendering transition
negative_tests: changed manifest after state binding rejected
changed approved plan cannot widen scope
worker acting as Unslop reviewer rejected
